meta.description: Integrate multiple scRNA-seq samples or batches with Harmony, scVI/scANVI, Seurat (CCA/RPCA), fastMNN, Scanorama, or BBKNN.
meta.audit_scope: Exact-commit remediation re-audit of every P1/P2 from the 2026-09-16 audit.

scientific_integrity.detail: The revised text distinguishes observed tuning behavior from a universal guarantee and keeps paired biological/batch evaluation mandatory.

practice_boundaries.detail: Research workflow only; no individual diagnosis, prescription, or triage.

methodological_ground.detail: The metadata confounding stop check now precedes cluster-based effect sizing.

code_usability.detail: The exact committed Harmony, scVI/scANVI, and Seurat RPCA scripts ran on synthetic audit fixtures and emitted their declared outputs.

functional_suitability.note: The Seurat RPCA command now includes its tested memory setting and wrapper methods are accurately bounded.

reliability.note: Both observed runtime failures now have actionable recovery guidance.

performance_context.note: The source remains compact; method-specific details load only through routed references.

agent_usability.note: Runnable commands expose inputs, output paths, seeds, and epochs.

human_usability.note: Confounded designs now have an explicit metadata-first stop rule.

security.note: Scripts validate batch/label keys and do not require credentials or network access.

maintainability.note: Canonical scripts and references replace copied blocks; no dedicated fixture ships with the skill.

agent_specific.note: Copied execution paths pin stochastic controls and explicit training duration.

inputs.label: Seeded Harmony source script
inputs.execution_note: scripts/harmony_integration.py ran on a 400-cell stratified synthetic fixture and wrote re_audit_harmony.h5ad containing X_pca and X_pca_harmony.

assertions.text: The documented exact command emits an integrated Harmony artifact with an uncorrected baseline.
assertions.note: Output artifact exists; Harmony converged in six iterations.

inputs.label: Seeded scVI/scANVI source script
inputs.execution_note: scripts/scvi_scanvi_integration.py ran on the 6,524-cell synthetic input with a reproducible partial-label column; both trainers stopped at max_epochs=2 and wrote re_audit_scvi.h5ad.

assertions.text: The copied scVI path sets scvi.settings.seed and an explicit epoch cap.
assertions.note: Runtime log reports Seed set to 0 and both trainers stopped at max_epochs=2.

inputs.label: Seurat v5 RPCA source script
inputs.execution_note: scripts/seurat_v5_integration.R ran through the audit R wrapper on a 400-cell synthetic Seurat object and wrote re_audit_seurat.rds.

assertions.text: RPCA has the documented future.globals.maxSize recovery before IntegrateLayers.
assertions.note: Source script completed and output RDS is 5,079,417 bytes.

inputs.label: Optional SeuratWrappers method boundary
inputs.execution_note: The exact Seurat source script was invoked with FastMNNIntegration in an environment without SeuratWrappers.

assertions.text: An unavailable wrapper method fails with an actionable dependency message.
assertions.note: Error named SeuratWrappers rather than reporting an unresolved bare symbol.

inputs.label: Confounded-design metadata guard
inputs.execution_note: run/re_audit_policy_checks.py checked the exact committed SKILL.md.

assertions.text: Condition-by-batch is the first explicit stop check.
assertions.note: The text stops when a condition occurs in only one batch and demotes cluster cross-tabs to effect sizing.

inputs.label: Scanorama and theta corrections
inputs.execution_note: run/re_audit_policy_checks.py checked the exact committed SKILL.md against the prior synthetic Scanorama/theta run evidence.

assertions.text: The two observed preconditions are stated without claiming that theta is an off switch.
assertions.note: Stable batch sorting, 0.5-5 starting scale, and theta=0 caveat are present.

inputs.label: Shipped-path structural check
inputs.execution_note: Python scripts py_compile; Seurat script parsed; every SKILL.md reference target exists at commit 8edc49c.

assertions.text: All routed scripts and reference files are present and syntactically valid.
assertions.note: No missing shipped asset or parse failure.

final.summary: All six prior P1/P2 findings are fixed and each remediation assertion passed on the exact committed source.
